title: PQF v1 conformance manifest
description: Schema for test-vectors/v1/manifest.json. The manifest lists identities (with private keys) used by the conformance runner and enumerates every positive and negative test vector under cases/.

Version.description: Manifest format version. 'v1' for the canonical committed set; 'v1-differential' for ephemeral randomized batches produced by the differential test driver.

Id.description: Short identifier referenced from each vector's `Identity` field.

PublicKey.description: Base64-encoded 1217-byte canonical PqfPublicKey (0x01 || X25519 (32) || ML-KEM-768 EK (1184)).

MlKem768PrivateKey.description: Base64-encoded serialized ML-KEM-768 decapsulation key produced by the crypto provider used to write the manifest. The on-disk representation is provider-defined (BouncyCastle's serialized form is the current canonical reference).

Identity.description: Identifier of the identity used to decrypt this vector.

Reason.description: Expected PqfRefusalReason member name (failure vectors only).

StreamingPostHocFailure.description: If true, the streaming reader is expected to emit plaintext before the post-hoc check fails; if false, the failure is detected before any plaintext is released.

PlaintextSha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the expected plaintext (success vectors only).
